summary: The code defines multiple statistical calculation functions for a reporting service, handling input validation and filtering out None values appropriately. Overall, the code is of good quality and performs safe mathematical operations using the built-in statistics module. (Large file analyzed in 3 parts.)

issues.description: Using pickle.loads on untrusted client data allows arbitrary code execution.
issues.suggestion: Use a safe serialization format such as json instead of pickle for untrusted input.

suggestions: Remove unused imports such as pickle if they are not needed in this module.
Consider refactoring the repeated statistical calculation logic into a shared helper function to reduce code duplication.
Consider factoring out the repeated mean and dispersion calculation into a helper function to adhere to the DRY principle.
Avoid using pickle for deserializing data from untrusted sources.
Refactor duplicated computation logic into a shared helper function.
